statements.status_notes: grpc-netty-shaded 1.85.0 drives its netty copy as an HTTP/2 client only and never uses netty's SPDY codec.
grpc-netty-shaded 1.85.0 drives its netty copy as an HTTP/2 client only and never builds an HttpServerCodec; the HTTP ports run on the unshaded netty 4.1.139.
grpc-netty-shaded 1.85.0 drives its netty copy as an HTTP/2 client only and never uses netty's WebSocket server extension handler.
